towns.name: Samsur
towns.summary: Samsur (2.8S 19.4E) was the first permanent town of the Gharu'ndim, built under Musansayn - the minor noble who led his people after Elysa and Thorsten freed them from the Olthoi and who made peace with the Aluvians - on the Yushad Ridge; it lies at the heart of the Gharu'ndim lands with roads north, south and into the A'mun Desert. A former Nexus starter town, it keeps the Victory Residential Halls, settlement portals and the nearby Mnemosyne collectors. In the DAT the town sits on a flat valley floor at z 0 entered from the south through a road gorge between 20 m sandstone mesas. Four sandstone Gharu'ndim halls (0x01000E11/0x01000E40) cluster around a tiny chamfered-corner square holding the Fountain of Musansayn ringed by blue-flame lamps; west of it stand the domed three-storey tavern, the glass-windowed church tower, the Nullified Statue of a Gromnie, the Town Network portal and the Life Stone, the meeting-hall tower to the east. On the west mesa above the gorge rises the 25 m Samsur Advocate Tower (0x010014C3) crowned by four orange beacon glows (0x0200069D).
